diagram_math_checks.evidence: Input Definition lines 37-39 declares A_M of dimension M, Q_N of dimension N, and a response qubit; v and r are qubits. The schematic names B for the original response. C is the reversible comparison of Step 2 on A_M,v with clean internal workspace; R_N,M is the finite unitary on A_M,v,Q_N, not an m-bit target. H_r acts on r; S_v acts on v,B,r; O_x acts on Q_N,r with N valid raw addresses.

Eight directed connectors join nine boxes exactly in Step 2 comparison/routing, Step 3 Hadamard/swap, Step 4 oracle, Step 5 reverse-swap/Hadamard/inverse-routing/inverse-comparison order. Top and bottom rows go right; middle row goes left. There is no commutativity assertion, closed edge, or controlled-oracle connector.

For j<N, Step 2 gives v=1 and Q_N=j. Step 3 produces B=|+>, r=|b>; the ordinary XOR action of def-qa-14-boolean-search-query-model yields r=|b XOR x_{j+1}>. The second Fredkin S_v restores r=|+> and returns that response to B. H_r then gives |0> by the displayed H matrix in def-qc-one-qubit-gate-alphabet-and-rotations.

For j>=N, v=0, Q_N=0 and both swaps are identities; O_x acts on r=|+>, invariant under either I or X, so B is unchanged with no phase. H clears r. Since A_M,v,Q_N were preserved by the response operations and oracle, the same R_N,M inverse clears Q_N, then C inverse clears v. Clean comparison workspace is supplied by alg-qc-reversible-embedding. Linearity gives the same ancilla factor for superpositions, matching def-qc-clean-and-dirty-ancillas.

The picture is explicitly for N<M. N=M (including N=1) uses the unchanged Step 1 direct call on A_M,B. The entire original Definition is byte-identical and complete without the picture; no proof or algorithmic obligation is delegated to the diagram.
